tables.name: pose_induced_apparent_asymmetry
rows: yaw, dz=20 mm (alar base vs nose tip), 2*dz*sin(theta)
yaw, dz=40 mm (eye corners vs nose tip), 2*dz*sin(theta)
roll or cant across b=60 mm, b*sin(phi)
midline angle over L=120 mm (nasion-menton), L*tan(alpha)
tables.notes: Derived arithmetic. dz = depth of the bilateral pair behind the midline reference; dz values approximate. Use to gate asymmetry estimates against pose uncertainty. Subject 10 cm off-axis at 40 cm is viewed ~14 deg obliquely.

tables.name: fitting_prior_sigmas
tables.notes: sigma_sym applies per axis to d = X_l - Mirror(X_r) (= 2A); mean |d| ~ 1.6 sigma. Calibrate so sampled |d| mostly 0.5-4.5 mm (PubMed 23112933) and surface RMSD ~0.8 mm. Use Student-t (nu~4) or Huber. Current face3d/solve/bundle.py defaults: sigma_sym=2.0, sigma_mid=1.5 uniform. Plane-fit weights: upper face 1.0, midface 0.5, lower face 0.25, ears 0.1.

tables.notes: Flags prompt user confirmation, never auto-correct. The 1.5 and 0.3 mm RMSD bounds are design choices bracketing the sourced 0.8 +/- 0.2 mm.
